negative_twin: Lifting does not define why absence may later occur.
Defaulting without a residual erases absence and can create false certainty.
Propagation depends on operator and missingness kind and is not universally strict.
Not applicable is not unknown, absent or zero.
Invalid is not missing and should retain the offending carrier/evidence when safe.
Unbound is a design-time partiality state, not runtime null.
Unknown cannot be collapsed to False and polarity/preconditions remain explicit.
Unknown cannot be collapsed to True or ordinary absence.
Stale status cannot prove current health or failure.
Condition-specific polarity, severity and authority prevent generic Boolean folding.
Partial effect is not atomic failure and requires recovery/compensation evidence.
Missingness mechanism is an evidence-backed hypothesis, not readable from null alone.
Imputed values are not observations and must not erase model assumptions.
Interpolation depends on phenomenon semantics and is not observation.
Extrapolation carries stronger assumptions and distinct uncertainty from interpolation.
Censoring and truncation change likelihood and population semantics differently.
Withheld is not unknown to the source and must preserve authority and disclosure status.
A point estimate without uncertainty and estimand is not a complete analytical result.
Confidence is a procedure coverage property, not posterior probability of this fixed parameter.
Prediction intervals include future variability and are not parameter confidence intervals.
Credible interval meaning depends on model/prior and is not frequentist coverage.
A bound is not an estimate and open/closed, valid/heuristic status matters.
A quantile requires distribution, conditioning and level and is not a generic confidence score.

input_contract: stochastic model, horizon and random stream
negative_twin: Sample paths are simulated realizations, not observed future trajectories.
Root-sum-of-squares is conditional on the measurement model and covariance assumptions.
Marginals alone are insufficient when inputs are dependent.

input_contract: model, input distributions and random stream
negative_twin: Simulation error, model error and input uncertainty remain separate.
Evidence combination is dependence/model sensitive and does not itself authorize acceptance.
Calibration is population/time scoped and can drift.
Thresholding is a policy decision, not model truth or execution authority.
Dependency and wrapping can widen bounds; interval arithmetic is not a probability model.
Set-valued possibility does not assign probabilities or preferences.
Conflict cannot be erased by coalesce, timestamp or majority without policy and residuals.
Row count or end-of-stream alone does not prove population completeness.
Aggregates over incomplete data need explicit bias/bounds, not ordinary finality.
Quality measurement is not fitness judgment, repair authority or acceptance.
Appraisal is not truth, relying-party acceptance or execution authority.
A view is not stored complete data and same shape does not preserve meaning.
Readable rows do not imply total updateability or safe mutation.
Rounded equality is not value identity and may be non-invertible.
Decodability does not imply losslessness or preservation of analytical fitness.
Unknown is not infeasible; feasible is not optimal; equal objectives do not identify solutions.
